summary: 我们考虑自对偶杨米尔斯和自对偶引力的标量作用。我们给出了它们的无限对称塔的新颖恢复版本。我们证明，对应于无限塔的各个能级的对称性沃德恒等式给出了波函数系数的软极限，而它们的恢复版本完全固定了整个波函数。我们的分析对于一般边界条件是有效的。最后，我们给出了 $n$ 点波函数系数的显式公式，作为重组扰动器解的单个行列式，该行列式也满足软极限。

title: All-multiplicity $\textrm{AdS}_4$ correlators in the self-dual sector
abstract: It was recently shown that tree-level gluon correlators of any multiplicity in $\textrm{AdS}_4$ admit an expansion in terms of flat-space scattering amplitudes, where lower-point amplitudes in the expansion depend on merged external data. We derive here analogous formulae for correlators of scalar theories which encode the self-dual sectors of Yang-Mills theory and gravity in this background. In the latter case, the amplitudes are differential operators which can be obtained from the former using a simple double copy prescription in terms of kinematic numerators satisfying color-kinematics duality.
summary: 最近的研究表明，$\textrm{AdS}_4$ 中任何多重性的树级胶子相关器都允许在平坦空间散射幅度方面进行扩展，其中扩展中的较低点幅度取决于合并的外部数据。我们在这里推导了标量理论相关器的类似公式，这些公式在这种背景下编码了杨-米尔斯理论和引力的自对偶部分。在后一种情况下，幅度是微分算子，可以使用满足颜色运动学对偶性的运动学分子的简单双拷贝规定从前者获得。

title: Strongly non-linear continuous model for wave propagation in 2D granular media: derivation and hyperbolicity analysis
abstract: In this work, we develop a nonlinear continuum model for wave propagation in two-dimensional granular materials, building on key ideas from Nesterenko's work. Starting from the Hertzian contact law and neglecting contact friction, we derive an effective continuum description through homogenization, assuming spherical, monodisperse grains, local periodicity, and the Cauchy--Born hypothesis. The resulting strain-gradient model depends on both the first and second gradients of the displacement field. We analyse the hyperbolicity of the leading-order system through its eigenvalues and eigenvectors, establishing conditions for hyperbolicity within a restricted deformation domain. The model is solved using an explicit finite-volume method to investigate gravitational settling and wave propagation. We derive analytical expressions for the longitudinal and transverse wave speeds and highlight their dependence on depth. Finally, the predictions of the continuum model are compared with existing discrete-element simulations. This formulation allows several extensions, including more complex packing geometries, contact laws, and large-deformation regimes in which the contact network can evolve.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们基于 Nesterenko 工作的关键思想，开发了二维颗粒材料中波传播的非线性连续模型。从赫兹接触定律出发，忽略接触摩擦，我们通过均质化推导出有效的连续介质描述，假设球形、单分散颗粒、局部周期性和柯西玻恩假设。所得的应变梯度模型取决于位移场的第一和第二梯度。我们通过特征值和特征向量分析前导系统的双曲性，在受限变形域内建立双曲性的条件。该模型使用显式有限体积方法求解，以研究重力沉降和波传播。我们推导出纵波速度和横波速度的解析表达式，并强调它们对深度的依赖性。最后，将连续体模型的预测与现有的离散元模拟进行比较。

该公式允许多种扩展，包括更复杂的堆积几何形状、接触定律以及接触网络可以演化的大变形状态。

title: Quasideterminants and differential realizations of W-algebras
abstract: In this work, we study the Hamiltonian reduction, used in constructing finite rectangular $W$-algebras, of the big-cell differential realization of $\mathfrak{gl}_{np}$. We establish an intrinsic factorization of the reduced differential realization, identifying its Yangian action with the coproduct action on a tensor product of $n$ evaluation differential realizations of $\mathfrak{gl}_p$. Corner quasideterminants provide the essential noncommutative mechanism through which Hamiltonian reduction transforms the higher-rank differential realization into a factorized lower-rank Yangian action.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们研究了 $\mathfrak{gl}_{np}$ 大单元微分实现的哈密顿量约简，用于构造有限矩形 $W$-代数。我们建立了约简微分实现的内在因式分解，将其杨格作用与对 $\mathfrak{gl}_p$ 的 $n$ 评估微分实现的张量积的余积作用进行识别。角准行列式提供了必要的非交换机制，通过该机制，哈密顿量约简将高阶微分实现转换为因式分解的低阶 Yangian 作用。

title: Spin Toda systems and N-point spherical Whittaker functions
abstract: We define and study a spin version of the open Toda integrable system, using the Iwasawa decomposition of a connected split real Lie group. We study spherical Whittaker functions as solutions of the spin Toda system. We also construct their N-point version and find the corresponding factorisation of the Casimir element, which yields asymptotic boundary KZB type equations.
summary: 我们使用连通分裂实李群的 Iwasawa 分解来定义和研究开放 Toda 可积系统的自旋版本。我们研究球形 Whittaker 函数作为自旋 Toda 系统的解。我们还构建了它们的 N 点版本并找到了卡西米尔元素的相应因式分解，从而产生了渐近边界 KZB 型方程。

title: Averages of traces and ratios of characteristic polynomials of random unitary matrices
abstract: In this work we explore the extent to which the Ratios Theorem for averages over $U(N)$, with respect to Haar measure, of ratios of characteristic polynomials can be used to evaluate averages of traces of unitary matrices. We derive concrete expressions for all averages involving up to 4 traces, valid for any matrix size, $N$. We also calculate the so-called zero-swap and one-swap contributions to an average with any number of traces, which amounts to determining general trace moments in a range double the size of the renowned result of Diaconis and Shahshahani. The expression is tractable enough to use in applications, for example to determine the parameter range where certain trace averages assume negative values.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们探讨了特征多项式比率超过 $U(N)$ 的平均值的比率定理（相对于哈尔测度）可用于评估酉矩阵迹的平均值的程度。我们推导出涉及最多 4 条迹线的所有平均值的具体表达式，对于任何矩阵大小 $N$ 均有效。我们还计算了所谓的零交换和一交换对任意数量迹线平均值的贡献，这相当于确定一般迹矩，其范围是 Diaconis 和 Shahshahani 著名结果的两倍。该表达式足够容易处理，可以在应用中使用，例如确定某些迹线平均值呈现负值的参数范围。

title: On Trace Averages and Sharp Asymptotics for Powers of Haar-Unitary Matrices
abstract: For a Haar-distributed matrix $U \in U(N)$, Rains's power-map theorem represents the spectrum of $U^m$, $m \in \mathbb{N}$, as a superposition of independent lower-dimensional CUE spectra. We determine how this exact decomposition appears in trace moments and in sharp Gaussian and Poisson limit laws. For averages of mixed trace products, a Charlier--Ewens convolution separates the stable Wick term from its full finite-$N$ correction. A Fredholm factorisation gives sharp total-variation asymptotics for the normalised trace in four regimes, from fixed powers to $m\geq N$. For a fixed trace power $p$, coherent summation of the leading Laguerre correction yields the exact factor $e^{2/p}$. At the mean-spacing scale, we obtain a sharp Poisson limit for the unfolded spectrum of $U^m$ on a fixed interval as $N, m \rightarrow \infty$; its first-order correction, obtained via the second Charlier polynomial, quantifies the residual under-dispersion of local eigenvalue counts.
summary: 对于 Haar 分布矩阵 $U \in U(N)$，雷恩斯功率图定理将 $U^m$、$m \in \mathbb{N}$ 的频谱表示为独立低维 CUE 频谱的叠加。我们确定这种精确分解如何出现在迹矩以及尖锐的高斯和泊松极限定律中。对于混合迹乘积的平均值，Charlier-Ewens 卷积将稳定的 Wick 项与其完整的有限 $N$ 校正分开。 Fredholm 因式分解为从固定幂到 $m\geq N$ 的四种状态下的归一化迹提供了尖锐的全变分渐近。对于固定的迹线功率 $p$，领先拉盖尔校正的相干求和产生精确的因子 $e^{2/p}$。在平均间距尺度上，我们在固定间隔 $N, m \rightarrow \infty$ 上获得 $U^m$ 展开谱的锐泊松极限；通过第二个 Charlier 多项式获得的一阶校正可量化局部特征值计数的残余欠离散度。

title: The solution of the Hopfield model with Gaussian patterns
abstract: We prove that the free energy of the Hopfield model with Gaussian patterns has a thermodynamic limit at every load $\alpha$ and temperature $T$, and we give it as an explicit variational principle. The Hubbard--Stratonovich transformation maps the model onto $N$ Ising spins coupled to $M=\alpha N$ Gaussian hidden units, whose radius, the empirical variance of the hidden layer, is a thermodynamic variable with an entropic cost. At fixed radius the model is an Ising--spherical spin glass with Gaussian couplings, which we solve. The principle (i) reproduces the Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky theory as its replica-symmetric restriction, (ii) identifies $T_g=1+\sqrt\alpha$ as the rigorous boundary of the annealed region, (iii) selects a unique spin-glass solution of the AGS equations, and (iv) gives the radius an equation of state. Moreover, (v) below $T_g$ we prove that replica symmetry is broken throughout: the instability of the AGS solution reduces to the zero-field de Almeida-Thouless condition of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model.
summary: 我们证明了具有高斯模式的 Hopfield 模型的自由能在每个载荷 $\alpha$ 和温度 $T$ 下都有热力学极限，并且我们将其作为显式变分原理给出。哈伯德-斯特拉托诺维奇变换将模型映射到与 $M=\alpha N$ 高斯隐藏单元耦合的 $N$ Ising 自旋，其半径（隐藏层的经验方差）是具有熵成本的热力学变量。在固定半径下，模型是伊辛球面自旋玻璃，具有高斯耦合，我们对此进行了求解。原理 (i) 将 Amit-Gutfreund-Sompolinsky 理论再现为其复制对称限制，(ii) 将 $T_g=1+\sqrt\alpha$ 识别为退火区域的严格边界，(iii) 选择 AGS 方程的唯一自旋玻璃解，以及 (iv) 给出半径的状态方程。此外，在 (v) 低于 $T_g$ 时，我们证明复制对称性被彻底破坏：AGS 解的不稳定性降低到 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型的零场 de Almeida-Thouless 条件。

title: Correlation-induced suppression of Granger causality and Gaussian transfer entropy
abstract: In complex dynamical systems, Granger causality and transfer entropy are widely used to infer directional interactions, but they quantify a source's unique predictive contribution after conditioning and can therefore be substantially attenuated by correlation with the retained variables. Here, using our previously developed Linear Operator Causality Analysis (LOCA) framework, which measures causal response from the system propagator, we derive a relationship between predictive and operator-based causality. For a two-dimensional linear system, the fractional suppression of Granger causality equals the squared correlation between source and receiver. We generalize this result to high-dimensional systems using the source covariance remaining after conditioning and show that additional conditioning can only increase the suppression. The same covariance ordering yields a corresponding upper bound for Gaussian transfer entropy. A linearized Burgers advection chain exhibits 36.6% suppression at the convective travel-time peak, and exact nonlinear acoustic Burgers solutions show that the fitted-surrogate penalty is governed by correlation structure rather than nonlinearity and remains robust to sensor noise after operator debiasing. Applied to resting-state fMRI from the Human Connectome Project (80 brain regions, 8 functional networks, 10 subjects), the single-lag Granger causality measure falls 39.4% below the operator response when conditioning only on the receiver and 73.0% when conditioning on the receiver and all other retained variables. The framework provides a quantitative bridge between predictive and operator-based causal measures in high-dimensional dynamical systems.
summary:
在复杂的动力系统中，格兰杰因果关系和传递熵被广泛用于推断方向相互作用，但它们量化了调节后源的独特预测贡献，因此可以通过与保留变量的相关性而大大减弱。在这里，使用我们之前开发的线性算子因果关系分析（LOCA）框架（该框架测量系统传播器的因果响应），我们得出了预测因果关系和基于算子的因果关系之间的关系。对于二维线性系统，格兰杰因果关系的分数抑制等于源和接收器之间的平方相关性。我们使用调节后剩余的源协方差将此结果推广到高维系统，并表明额外的调节只能增加抑制。相同的协方差排序产生高斯转移熵的相应上限。

线性化 Burgers 平流链在对流传播时间峰值处表现出 36.6% 的抑制，并且精确的非线性声学 Burgers 解决方案表明，拟合代理惩罚由相关结构而不是非线性控制，并且在算子去偏后对传感器噪声保持鲁棒性。应用于人类连接组项目的静息态 fMRI（80 个大脑区域、8 个功能网络、10 名受试者）时，单滞后格兰杰因果关系测量在仅调节接收器时比操作员响应低 39.4%，在调节接收器和所有其他保留变量时比操作员响应低 73.0%。该框架在高维动力系统中的预测和基于算子的因果测量之间提供了一座定量桥梁。

title: Variance of relative entropy over random states
abstract: Average relative entropy over major generic random states is recently studied. In this work, the investigation is extended by deriving the variances of relative entropy over the Hilbert--Schmidt and Bures--Hall ensembles, which characterize its fluctuations around the average value. Exact results for the variances of relative entropy between independent states drawn from the same ensemble and from two different ensembles are obtained. These results further indicate that the average relative entropy is typical in the considered limiting regimes. In addition to the matrix-level calculations similar to the average relative entropy, eigenvalue correlation functions of the ensembles are involved in the variance computations through the use of zonal polynomials.
summary: 最近研究了主要通用随机状态的平均相对熵。在这项工作中，通过推导 Hilbert-Schmidt 和 Bures-Hall 系综上相对熵的方差来扩展研究，该方差表征了其围绕平均值的波动。获得了从同一系综和两个不同系综得出的独立状态之间相对熵方差的精确结果。这些结果进一步表明平均相对熵在所考虑的限制范围内是典型的。除了类似于平均相对熵的矩阵级计算之外，系综的特征值相关函数还通过使用区域多项式参与方差计算。

title: Ideal interaction dynamics of defects and background fields in condensed matter
abstract: While defect dynamics in condensed matter systems is widely studied and several methods are available to track the defect position over time, the formulation of dynamical models for the coupled evolution of both defect and background field quantities seems to be more challenging. Yet, the overall behavior of a system containing moving defects is strongly influenced by this defect-field interaction. Here, we propose a modeling framework for the conservative coupled evolution of the defect density and the background fields upon focusing on two relevant cases of study: the Gross-Pitaevskii theory of quantum fluids and the Ericksen-Leslie model of nematic liquid crystals. To achieve the coupled evolution, we combine the Euler-Poincaré variational setting of continuum dynamics with the gauge theory of topological defects. While the latter allows us to overcome certain ambiguities in definition of the defect density, the Euler-Poincaré method provides a unified modeling approach in the absence of defect reconnection.
summary: 虽然凝聚态系统中的缺陷动力学得到了广泛的研究，并且有几种方法可以跟踪缺陷位置随时间的变化，但缺陷和背景场量耦合演化的动力学模型的制定似乎更具挑战性。然而，包含移动缺陷的系统的整体行为受到这种缺陷场相互作用的强烈影响。在这里，我们提出了一个缺陷密度和背景场保守耦合演化的建模框架，重点关注两个相关的研究案例：量子流体的 Gross-Pitaevskii 理论和向列液晶的 Ericksen-Leslie 模型。为了实现耦合演化，我们将连续介质动力学的欧拉-庞加莱变分设置与拓扑缺陷的规范理论相结合。虽然后者使我们能够克服缺陷密度定义中的某些模糊性，但欧拉-庞加莱方法在没有缺陷重连接的情况下提供了统一的建模方法。

title: Mutual Information Across Quantum Reference Frame Perspectives
abstract: In quantum information theory, standard notions typically presuppose a fixed partition of the world into subsystems, encoded in a tensor product structure of the Hilbert space. Yet, in some scenarios, the subsystem structure is not uniquely fixed. A case in point is the description of subsystems relative to different quantum reference frames (QRFs), where the tensor product structure, although fixed in a specific QRF, changes across different QRFs. Such a relativity of subsystems underlies many interesting features of QRFs, such as the relativity of entanglement, entropy, and coherence. It also raises a broader question: how do we compare the information across different subsystem perspectives, especially when the corresponding subsystem algebras overlap? Here, we propose a notion of quantum mutual information across different QRF perspectives, which captures the correlations between subsystems relative to different frames of reference. To do so, we focus on an algebraic definition of subsystems. Studying in detail the union and overlap between subsystem algebras relative to different QRFs, we find that the usual definition of mutual information in terms of the chain law overcounts the information associated to the overlap. Based on this insight, we propose a modified chain law and show that the resulting notion of mutual information satisfies subadditivity and connects naturally to other measures found in the literature [1]. Our investigations not only provide a way to quantify the relation between different QRF perspectives from an information-theoretic point of view but also sheds light on some important features of quantum information in absence of a fixed tensor product structure.
summary:
在量子信息论中，标准概念通常预设世界被固定划分为子系统，并以希尔伯特空间的张量积结构进行编码。然而，在某些场景下，子系统结构并不是唯一固定的。一个典型的例子是相对于不同量子参考系（QRF）的子系统描述，其中张量积结构虽然固定在特定的 QRF 中，但在不同的 QRF 中会发生变化。子系统的这种相对性是 QRF 许多有趣特征的基础，例如纠缠、熵和相干性的相对性。它还提出了一个更广泛的问题：我们如何比较不同子系统视角的信息，特别是当相应的子系统代数重叠时？在这里，我们提出了跨不同 QRF 视角的量子互信息的概念，它捕获了相对于不同参考系的子系统之间的相关性。为此，我们关注子系统的代数定义。

详细研究相对于不同 QRF 的子系统代数之间的并集和重叠，我们发现根据链定律对互信息的通常定义超出了与重叠相关的信息。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种修改后的链定律，并表明由此产生的互信息概念满足次可加性，并自然地与文献中发现的其他措施联系起来[1]。我们的研究不仅提供了一种从信息论角度量化不同 QRF 视角之间关系的方法，而且还揭示了在没有固定张量积结构的情况下量子信息的一些重要特征。

title: The Entire Quantum Computer on a Classical Leash
abstract: We show that a classical client with no quantum hardware can use a single untrusted and potentially malicious quantum server as if it were its own trusted quantum computer. Through the server, the client can privately choose and run quantum computations, prepare quantum states, and process quantum states supplied by other parties. It can also keep quantum memory on the server, hidden from the server itself, and use that memory in later computations so its quantum state persists across rounds of interaction. Together, these capabilities let a purely classical party act as a quantum party in a variety of interactive protocols. We expect this virtual quantum computer to be a broadly useful tool. As immediate applications, we resolve two known open problems: (1) classical verification of quantum sampling with negligible computational soundness error, and (2) remote state preparation of arbitrary efficiently preparable quantum states. Underlying all of these results is a general-purpose, maliciously secure two-party computation protocol between a classical client and a quantum server, which we construct assuming only the post-quantum hardness of learning with errors.
summary: 我们证明，没有量子硬件的经典客户端可以使用单个不可信且可能恶意的量子服务器，就好像它是自己的可信量子计算机一样。通过服务器，客户端可以私下选择和运行量子计算、准备量子态以及处理其他方提供的量子态。它还可以将量子内存保留在服务器上，对服务器本身隐藏，并在以后的计算中使用该内存，以便其量子状态在交互轮次中持续存在。这些功能共同让纯粹的经典方在各种交互协议中充当量子方。我们期望这种虚拟量子计算机成为一种广泛有用的工具。作为直接应用，我们解决了两个已知的开放问题：（1）计算稳健性误差可忽略不计的量子采样的经典验证，以及（2）任意有效可准备量子态的远程状态准备。所有这些结果的基础是经典客户端和量子服务器之间的通用、恶意安全的两方计算协议，我们构建该协议时仅假设错误学习的后量子难度。

title: Quantum Complexity and Stabilizer-State Expansions: From Pairing to Deformation in Fermionic Systems
abstract: Understanding how collective phenomena such as pairing and deformation emerge in interacting fermionic systems, and how the correlations underlying them shape the resources required for their simulation, is a central challenge in many-body physics. We investigate various aspects of quantum complexity in a fermionic system exhibiting two main forms of collectivity, specifically deformation and pairing, through entanglement, non-stabilizerness, and fermionic non-Gaussianity. In the deformed phase, high entanglement coexists with low non-stabilizerness, while the superfluid pairing phase, by contrast, exhibits substantial multipartite entanglement and non-stabilizerness, together with maximal fermionic anti-flatness. In a second step we examine how to describe the phase diagram of the system in a classically scalable and symmetry-preserving way, by combining stabilizer-state expansion and variational basis optimization. A physics-guided decomposition of the Hamiltonian identifies the relevant stabilizer states, which can be constructed from graph states. A single stabilizer state captures the deformed phase to a large extent, and, although the number of stabilizer states required to describe the pairing phase grows exponentially with system size, a symmetry-preserving basis rotation yields a high-fidelity approximation using far fewer states. This rotated state can then serve as a practical starting point for quantum refinement.
summary:
了解配对和变形等集体现象如何在相互作用的费米子系统中出现，以及它们背后的相关性如何塑造模拟所需的资源，是多体物理学的一个核心挑战。我们通过纠缠、非稳定性和费米子非高斯性研究了费米子系统中量子复杂性的各个方面，该系统表现出两种主要的集体形式，特别是变形和配对。在变形相中，高纠缠度与低非稳定度共存，而相比之下，超流体配对相则表现出大量的多部分纠缠和非稳定度，以及最大的费米子反平坦性。在第二步中，我们研究如何通过结合稳定器状态扩展和变分基优化，以经典的可扩展和对称性保持的方式描述系统的相图。哈密​​顿量的物理引导分解可识别相关的稳定器状态，这些状态可以从图状态构建。

单个稳定器状态在很大程度上捕获变形相位，并且尽管描述配对相位所需的稳定器状态数量随着系统尺寸呈指数增长，但保持对称性的基础旋转使用少得多的状态产生高保真度近似。这种旋转状态可以作为量子细化的实际起点。

title: Optimal Control of a Fluxonium Circuit with the Q-PRONTO Numerical Method
abstract: Optimizing the control of large quantum systems is a resource-intensive task, where the convergence rate of the underlying iterative schemes is crucial. The recently developed Quantum Projection Operator-Based Newton Method for Trajectory Optimization (Q-PRONTO) offers a unique quadratic convergence for controlling quantum states, while most model-based solvers guarantee only an approximately linear convergence rate. As a proof of concept, here, we design and benchmark single-qubit gates optimized by Q-PRONTO based on the circuit Hamiltonian of a fluxonium superconducting qubit. To ensure that we can apply a long string of arbitrary pulses to the circuit, we modify the firmware associated with the Quantum Instrumentation Control Kit (QICK) by altering its memory allocation. We characterize the performance of the optimal solutions using standard randomized benchmarking and achieve a total error per gate of $6.6\times10^{-4}$.
summary: 优化大型量子系统的控制是一项资源密集型任务，其中底层迭代方案的收敛速度至关重要。最近开发的基于量子投影算子的牛顿轨迹优化方法（Q-PRONTO）为控制量子态提供了独特的二次收敛，而大多数基于模型的求解器仅保证近似线性的收敛速率。作为概念证明，我们在这里基于 Fluxium 超导量子位的电路哈密顿量，设计并基准测试了由 Q-PRONTO 优化的单量子位门。为了确保我们可以向电路应用一长串任意脉冲，我们通过改变内存分配来修改与量子仪器控制套件 (QICK) 相关的固件。我们使用标准随机基准测试来表征最佳解决方案的性能，并实现每个门的总误差为 $6.6\times10^{-4}$。

title: Noise-Assisted Quantum Entanglement: Memory-Enhanced Coherence in Stochastic Jaynes-Cummings Dynamics
abstract: We investigate qubit entanglement dynamics in a two-qubit cavity system with stochastically fluctuating coupling strength, comparing white noise (Markovian) and Ornstein-Uhlenbeck noise (non-Markovian) processes. We analytically solve the system dynamics for both Fock and coherent cavity states and systematically characterize how initial qubit configurations affect entanglement generation and preservation. Our results reveal distinct dynamical regimes: in the Fock-state cavity, initial states in the single-excitation subspace generate robust qubit entanglement in decoherence-free subspaces, while initially entangled states in the double-excitation subspace exhibit inevitable decay without protective symmetries. For coherent cavities, we identify a critical photon-number threshold in the intermediate coherent-state amplitude regime where dynamics transition from low-frequency to high-frequency entanglement oscillations, while universal entanglement loss occurs at large amplitudes. Remarkable resilience against entanglement sudden death emerges under strong non-Markovian noise with long correlation times, where repeated revivals occur. These findings establish cavity photon statistics and environmental memory time as key control parameters for engineering qubit entanglement dynamics in qubit-cavity systems, revealing how system-environment correlations govern quantum information preservation.
summary:
我们研究了具有随机波动耦合强度的两个量子位腔系统中的量子位纠缠动力学，比较了白噪声（马尔可夫）和 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 噪声（非马尔可夫）过程。我们分析解决了福克和相干腔态的系统动力学，并系统地表征了初始量子位配置如何影响纠缠的生成和保存。我们的结果揭示了不同的动力学机制：在福克态腔中，单激发子空间中的初始态在无退相干子空间中产生鲁棒的量子比特纠缠，而双激发子空间中的初始纠缠态表现出不可避免的衰变，没有保护对称性。对于相干腔，我们确定了中间相干态振幅范围内的临界光子数阈值，其中动态从低频纠缠振荡过渡到高频纠缠振荡，而普遍纠缠损失发生在大振幅处。在具有长相关时间的强非马尔可夫噪声下，出现了针对纠缠猝死的显着恢复能力，其中发生了重复的复兴。

这些发现将腔光子统计和环境记忆时间确立为量子位腔系统中工程量子位纠缠动力学的关键控制参数，揭示了系统-环境相关性如何控制量子信息保存。

title: Additive uncertainty relations via pseudospectral methods
abstract: Given Hermitian observable $A$, the variance of $A$ is given by the difference of expectations $\langle A^2\rangle - \langle A\rangle^2$, where the expectation of an observable implicitly assumes a choice of state for the underlying system. As a sub-case of a general lower bound for the sum of variances for finitely many arbitrary elements in a $C^*$-algebra, we prove that the sum of the variances for $d$ observables $A_1, \dots , A_d$ is greater than some expression in the expectations $\langle i[A_j,A_k]\rangle$ for $j\neq k$ plus the square of the smallest singular value of the associated localizer. In special cases, this expression is just a root mean square average. Our technique also derives a general containment between the Clifford pseudospectra and quadratic pseudospectra for $d$ observables.
summary: 给定 Hermitian 可观测量 $A$，$A$ 的方差由期望值 $\langle A^2\rangle - \langle A\rangle^2$ 之差给出，其中可观测量的期望隐含地假设了底层系统的状态选择。作为 $C^*$ 代数中有限多个任意元素的方差总和的一般下界的子情况，我们证明 $d$ 可观测值 $A_1​​, \dots , A_d$ 的方差总和大于 $j\neq k$ 的期望 $\langle i[A_j,A_k]\rangle$ 中的某个表达式加上相关定位器的最小奇异值的平方。在特殊情况下，该表达式只是均方根平均值。我们的技术还得出 $d$ 可观测量的 Clifford 伪谱和二次伪谱之间的一般包含。

title: Real-space construction and selection rules of center-of-mass momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional many-body lattices
abstract: We present a comprehensive framework for the real-space construction of center-of-mass (c.m.) momentum eigenstates in two-dimensional (2D) quantum many-body systems. Unlike standard momentum-space approaches, our real-space formalism explicitly captures the non-uniformity of cyclic subspace dimensions, which are fundamentally governed by the spatial symmetries of the many-body configurations and particle statistics. We demonstrate that performing 2D real-space translations on multi-particle states naturally induces non-trivial translation phase factors associated with the characters of these stabilizer subgroups, leading to a renormalization of permissible momentum values. Notably, we identify an anomalous cross-dimensional momentum coupling in highly symmetric particle distributions, where the permissible momentum values in one direction are strictly constrained by those in the perpendicular direction. We emphasize the algorithmic necessity of this coupling, as neglecting it leads to missing or duplicated basis states in numerical implementations. Concrete examples are provided to demonstrate the practical implementation and physical consequences of this framework.
summary: 我们提出了一个用于二维 (2D) 量子多体系统中质心 (c.m.) 动量本征态的实空间构造的综合框架。与标准动量空间方法不同，我们的实空间形式明确地捕获了循环子空间维度的不均匀性，这从根本上受多体配置和粒子统计的空间对称性控制。我们证明，在多粒子状态上执行 2D 实空间平移自然会引起与这些稳定子组的特征相关的重要平移相位因子，从而导致允许动量值的重整化。值得注意的是，我们在高度对称的粒子分布中发现了一种异常的跨维度动量耦合，其中一个方向上的允许动量值严格受到垂直方向上的动量值的约束。我们强调这种耦合的算法必要性，因为忽略它会导致数值实现中基本状态的丢失或重复。提供了具体示例来演示该框架的实际实现和物理后果。

title: Quantum Cryptomania with Classical Communication without One-Way Functions
abstract: In classical cryptography, one-way functions are necessary for most of cryptography. In the quantum world, however, Kretschmer at {TQC'21} and subsequent works have demonstrated that quantum versions of various primitives in minicrypt, such as signatures and private-key encryption, do not require quantum-computable one-way functions (\textsf{qOWF}s). However, the question of the necessity of \textsf{qOWF}s for primitives in Cryptomania like public-key encryption with classical public keys and ciphertexts (\textsf{qPKE}) has remained open. We provide a comprehensive picture of the relationship between \textsf{qPKE} and \textsf{qOWF}. First, our main result is a black-box separation between \textsf{qOWF}s and \textsf{qPKE}. In particular, we show that relative to a unitary, real, and self-inverse oracle, there exists a \textsf{qPKE} scheme (with classical keys and ciphertexts), but \textsf{qOWF}s do not exist. Further, our oracles admit a point-function obfuscation construction, thus ruling out black-box construction of \textsf{qOWF} from point function obfuscations. On the positive side, we construct \textsf{qPKE} from quantum indistinguishability obfuscation for quantum circuits with classical obfuscated descriptions and efficiently verifiable one-way puzzles, which is known to be a potentially weaker assumption than \textsf{qOWF}s, due to an existing black-box separation. Our construction is the quantum analog of the classical construction of \textsf{PKE} from one-way functions and indistinguishability obfuscation in the quantum computation with classical communication (QCCC) setting.
summary:
在经典密码学中，单向函数对于大多数密码学来说是必需的。然而，在量子世界中，{TQC'21} 的 Kretschmer 和后续工作已经证明，minicrypt 中各种原语的量子版本（例如签名和私钥加密）不需要量子可计算的单向函数（\textsf{qOWF}s）。然而，对于 Cryptomania 中的原语（例如使用经典公钥和密文（\textsf{qPKE}）进行公钥加密）的必要性问题仍然悬而未决。我们提供了 \textsf{qPKE} 和 \textsf{qOWF} 之间关系的全面描述。首先，我们的主要结果是 \textsf{qOWF} 和 \textsf{qPKE} 之间的黑盒分离。特别是，我们证明相对于单一、实数和自逆的预言机，存在一个 \textsf{qPKE} 方案（具有经典密钥和密文），但 \textsf{qOWF} 不存在。此外，我们的预言机承认点函数混淆构造，从而排除了来自点函数混淆的 \textsf{qOWF} 的黑盒构造。

从积极的一面来看，我们通过量子电路的量子不可区分性混淆构造了 \textsf{qPKE} ，具有经典的混淆描述和有效可验证的单向谜题，由于现有的黑盒分离，已知这是一个比 \textsf{qOWF}s 潜在更弱的假设。我们的构造是经典构造 \textsf{PKE} 的量子模拟，来自经典通信量子计算（QCCC）设置中的单向函数和不可区分性混淆。

title: Trident: Efficient Load Verification for Yoked Surface Codes using a Three-Level Memory Hierarchy
abstract: Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computers (FTQCs) commonly use the surface code to encode program qubits as error-corrected logical qubits. Unfortunately, the surface code has a poor encoding rate, so recent work has proposed Yoked Surface Codes (YSCs), which concatenate the surface code with a high-rate quantum code. The surface code qubits in YSCs are protected by the checks, or yokes, of the high-rate code. YSCs have 1D and 2D variants, which are $1.8\times$ and $4.5\times$ more efficient than the surface code, respectively. Modern FTQC architectures use a two-level hierarchy: surface codes perform logical operations (compute) while 2D YSCs store idle program qubits (memory). To load a qubit from memory, the FTQC first performs retrieval, which logically moves a program qubit from a 2D YSC into a surface code (8 cycles). However, retrieval is not fault-tolerant, so the FTQC must verify the load by measuring all the yokes of the 2D YSC (178 cycles). As verification dominates memory access latency, eliminating it can provide a speedup of $5.7\times$. Our goal is to reduce the verification overhead of 2D YSCs while retaining their storage efficiency. We exploit the fact that 1D YSCs, though less storage-efficient, incur negligible verification latency. We propose Trident, which expands the two-level hierarchy into a three-level hierarchy by adding a small intermediate level containing a 1D YSC (L1). If most loads hit L1 rather than L2 (2D YSC tier), it can significantly reduce verification overhead. We present two variants: Trident-D (demand-driven) and Trident-P (prefetch-driven), which achieve speedups of $2.8\times$ and $4.2\times$, respectively, while increasing the physical qubit cost of memory by only 4.9%.
summary:
容错量子计算机 (FTQC) 通常使用表面代码将程序量子位编码为纠错逻辑量子位。不幸的是，表面码的编码率较差，因此最近的工作提出了轭表面码（YSC），它将表面码与高速量子码连接起来。 YSC 中的表面代码量子位受到高速代码的检查或轭的保护。 YSC 有 1D 和 2D 变体，分别比表面代码效率高 $1.8\times$ 和 $4.5\times$。现代 FTQC 架构使用两级层次结构：表面代码执行逻辑运算（计算），而 2D YSC 存储空闲程序量子位（内存）。为了从内存加载量子位，FTQC 首先执行检索，这会逻辑地将程序量子位从 2D YSC 移动到表面代码（8 个周期）。然而，检索不是容错的，因此 FTQC 必须通过测量 2D YSC 的所有磁轭（178 个周期）来验证负载。由于验证在内存访问延迟中占主导地位，消除它可以提供 5.7 美元\ 倍的加速。我们的目标是减少 2D YSC 的验证开销，同时保持其存储效率。

我们利用了这样一个事实：1D YSC 虽然存储效率较低，但所产生的验证延迟可以忽略不计。我们提出了 Trident，它通过添加一个包含 1D YSC (L1) 的小型中间层，将两级层次结构扩展为三级层次结构。如果大多数负载到达 L1 而不是 L2（2D YSC 层），则可以显着减少验证开销。我们提出了两种变体：Trident-D（需求驱动）和 Trident-P（预取驱动），它们分别实现了 2.8 美元和 4.2 美元的加速，而内存的物理量子位成本仅增加了 4.9%。

title: Quantum Evolution Networks Learn Long-Time Coherent Dynamics in Driven Spin Registers
abstract: Predicting and controlling driven quantum systems requires access to dynamics across physical parameters, initial states, and evolution times. A reusable neural model must capture this dependence while preserving unitary structure and maintaining accuracy over long-time coherent evolution. Here we introduce Quantum Evolution Networks (QENs), which map physical parameters and time to complete propagators for periodically driven three-spin registers. Shared networks learn unitary one-period propagators and compatible within-period paths, enabling predictions through known periodic composition without query-specific numerical integration. For transverse driving, the fifth-percentile fidelity, minimized over input states and sampled times, is 0.9947 over 24 periods on 256 held-out configurations. A leading-order analysis of spectrally resolved endpoint residuals predicts multicycle process error more accurately than quadratic or spectrum-averaged estimates. Interventions at matched single-period infidelity produce orders-of-magnitude differences in multicycle infidelity, demonstrating the importance of residual orientation. Compatible component replacements identify how endpoint and within-period approximations limit reconstruction accuracy. These results establish a reusable neural representation of the studied propagator families and connect its learned residual structure to its observed long-time reliability.
summary:
预测和控制驱动量子系统需要了解物理参数、初始状态和演化时间的动力学。可重用的神经模型必须捕获这种依赖性，同时保持单一结构并保持长期相干进化的准确性。在这里，我们介绍量子进化网络（QEN），它将物理参数和时间映射到周期性驱动的三自旋寄存器的完整传播器。共享网络学习单一的单周期传播器和兼容的周期内路径，从而可以通过已知的周期组合进行预测，而无需特定于查询的数值积分。对于横向驱动，在 256 个保留配置的 24 个周期内，在输入状态和采样时间上最小化的第五百分位保真度为 0.9947。光谱解析端点残差的前序分析比二次或光谱平均估计更准确地预测多周期过程误差。对匹配的单周期不忠行为的干预会在多周期不忠行为中产生数量级的差异，这证明了残余取向的重要性。

兼容的组件替换可确定端点和周期内近似如何限制重建精度。这些结果建立了所研究的传播器家族的可重复使用的神经表示，并将其学习的残差结构与其观察到的长期可靠性联系起来。

title: Bogoliubov Dynamics and Zitterbewegung in Optical Dirac Systems
abstract: We develop a bosonic Bogoliubov description of Zitterbewegung in time-dependent optical-Dirac systems. Within the optical-Dirac framework, the anomalous pair-creation and pair-annihilation terms of a bosonic Bogoliubov Hamiltonian correspond to couplings between the positive- and negative-frequency sectors, whose coherence underlies the Zitterbewegung response. When the constitutive parameters vary in time, the resulting moving-frame connection generates dynamical interbranch coupling and positive--negative-frequency coherence. Under periodic modulation, this coupling becomes resonant near $\Omega\simeq2\omega_0$, leading to parametric amplification of the coherence and consequently to an enhanced Zitterbewegung motion.
summary: 我们在瞬态光学狄拉克系统中开发了 Zitterbewegung 的玻色子 Bogoliubov 描述。在光学狄拉克框架内，玻色波戈留波夫哈密顿量的反常对产生和对湮灭项对应于正频率扇区和负频率扇区之间的耦合，其相干性是 Zitterbewegung 响应的基础。当本构参数随时间变化时，所产生的移动框架连接会产生动态分支间耦合和正负频率相干性。在周期性调制下，这种耦合在 $\Omega\simeq2\omega_0$ 附近发生谐振，导致相干性的参数放大，从而增强 Zitterbewegung 运动。

title: Traceable Quantum Secret Sharing
abstract: Quantum secret sharing protects distributed quantum information against unauthorized reconstruction, yet existing schemes provide no intrinsic accountability when shares are leaked or forged. This missing capability is particularly relevant in realistic distributed settings, where compromised participants may either expose valid shares or maliciously interfere with reconstruction. Here we establish a framework for traceable quantum secret sharing under these two threat models. We introduce leakage-verifiable and traceable quantum secret sharing (LVT-QSS), which attributes leaked shares through an explicit leakage verification mechanism, and malicious-traceable and accountable quantum secret sharing (MTA-QSS), which identifies participants who submit forged shares during reconstruction. We formulate security definitions for both settings and prove that the proposed protocols satisfy the corresponding guarantees against the relevant adversaries. Numerical simulations under per-share depolarizing noise further quantify the robustness of the proposed schemes and identify verification as the dominant noise sensitive stage. These results incorporate accountability into quantum secret sharing and provide a foundation for traceable distributed quantum cryptography.
summary:
量子秘密共享可以保护分布式量子信息免遭未经授权的重建，但现有方案在共享泄露或伪造时不提供内在的责任。这种缺失的功能在现实的分布式环境中尤其重要，其中受损的参与者可能会暴露有效的共享或恶意干扰重建。在这里，我们建立了在这两种威胁模型下可追溯的量子秘密共享的框架。我们引入了可泄漏验证和可追踪的量子秘密共享（LVT-QSS），它通过显式泄漏验证机制对泄漏的共享进行归属；以及恶意可追踪和负责任的量子秘密共享（MTA-QSS），它可以识别在重建过程中提交伪造共享的参与者。我们为这两种设置制定了安全定义，并证明所提出的协议满足针对相关对手的相应保证。每股去极化噪声下的数值模拟进一步量化了所提出方案的鲁棒性，并将验证确定为主要的噪声敏感阶段。

这些结果将问责制纳入量子秘密共享中，并为可追踪的分布式量子密码学提供了基础。

title: Two-Layer Verification for Fault-Tolerant Magic-State Preparation in High-Rate Quantum Codes
abstract: Encoded magic states are essential for universal fault-tolerant quantum computation, but their resource-efficient preparation in high-rate quantum codes remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose two-layer verification, which combines local verification of independently prepared subblocks with logical verification after their embedding into a target code. This hierarchy detects harmful error patterns, including even-parity logical-eigenvalue flips that are invisible to a collective product check alone. We demonstrate this scheme for a $[[21,3,5]]$ code by constructing a circuit that embeds three verified seven-qubit Steane-code magic states into the target code. Circuit-level simulations of $T$- and $S$-state preparation show logical-error suppression consistent with the code distance. These results demonstrate the potential of two-layer verification as a design principle for reliable magic-state preparation in quantum codes encoding multiple logical qubits.
summary: 编码幻态对于通用容错量子计算至关重要，但在高速量子代码中高效利用资源的准备仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这个限制，我们提出了两层验证，它将独立准备的子块的本地验证与嵌入到目标代码中后的逻辑验证结合起来。该层次结构可以检测有害的错误模式，包括偶校验逻辑特征值翻转，这些翻转对于单独的集体产品检查来说是不可见的。我们通过构建一个将三个经过验证的七量子位 Steane 代码魔术状态嵌入到目标代码中的电路来演示 $[[21,3,5]]$ 代码的方案。 $T$ 和 $S$ 状态准备的电路级仿真显示逻辑错误抑制与代码距离一致。这些结果证明了两层验证作为编码多个逻辑量子位的量子代码中可靠的魔态准备的设计原理的潜力。

title: Photon-Pair Advantage for Dissipative Parameter Estimation in Whispering-Gallery-Mode Interferometers
abstract: We study the estimation of detuning and intrinsic loss in a lossy whispering-gallery-mode (WGM) resonator located in a balanced Mach--Zehnder interferometer. We use indistinguishable photon pairs and coherent-state probes. We show that using indistinguishable photon pairs can provide higher Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) of dissipative parameters, such as intrinsic loss, at resonance away from critical coupling. Taking into account all photon-loss outcomes, we obtain analytical QFI expressions and compare photon-pair and coherent-state probe results when they have the same mean photon number. For estimating the round-trip amplitude transmission at resonance and away from critical coupling, the photon-pair probe gives a higher QFI than the coherent-state probe, and photon-number-resolved detection saturates this QFI. This advantage is due to the photon-loss statistics and it is still accessible for a typical overcoupled condition after averaging over fluctuations of the unresolved detuning. We identify the limits of this advantage: phase doubling does not improve resonant detuning estimation, and coincidence-only detection is inefficient close to a zero transmission. These results identify the cases in which photon pairs can be useful for absorption and pump--probe WGM sensing.
summary:
我们研究了位于平衡马赫曾德干涉仪中的有损回音壁模式 (WGM) 谐振器的失谐和固有损耗的估计。我们使用无法区分的光子对和相干态探针。我们证明，使用不可区分的光子对可以在远离临界耦合的共振处提供更高的耗散参数量子费希尔信息（QFI），例如固有损耗。考虑到所有光子损失结果，我们获得了解析 QFI 表达式，并比较了光子对和相干态探针具有相同平均光子数时的结果。为了估计谐振时和远离临界耦合的往返振幅传输，光子对探针提供比相干态探针更高的 QFI，并且光子数分辨检测使该 QFI 饱和。这一优点是由于光子损失统计数据造成的，并且在对未解决的失谐的波动进行平均后，对于典型的过耦合条件仍然可以实现。我们确定了这一优势的局限性：相位倍增并不能改善谐振失谐估计，并且仅重合检测在接近零传输时效率低下。

这些结果确定了光子对可用于吸收和泵浦-探针 WGM 传感的情况。

title: Classical Pre-Training of Large Shallow Parametrized Quantum Circuits through Pauli Propagation and deployment on Quantum Hardware
abstract: Scaling parametrized quantum circuits to a larger number of qubits is a central challenge in Quantum Machine Learning: gradient estimation via the parameter-shift rule quickly becomes prohibitively expensive, while gradient-free optimizers offer limited convergence guarantees. We apply the Pauli propagation framework to a broad class of Quantum Machine Learning problems in which the loss is expressed as a function of expectation values of the circuit's observables, while keeping the relevant quantity of interest, such as the quantum state or its samples, classically intractable to compute. By propagating the observables backward through the circuit, we obtain an explicit parametric expression for the loss that can be minimized entirely on classical hardware. We also present complementary strategies to make propagation tractable at large scale, including weight-based and degree-based truncations and pruning heuristics. We demonstrate the approach on two benchmarks run on 64-qubit circuits: Variational Quantum Eigensolver on a two-dimensional Ising model, and training of a discrete-type generative model for binary images. In both cases, the classically pre-trained parameters are deployed on the IBM quantum processor ibm_berlin. For generative learning, we additionally show that the circuits considered here require substantially fewer parametrized gates than IQP-style ansätze, reducing transpilation overhead and making deployment on current quantum hardware feasible.
summary:
将参数化量子电路扩展到更多数量的量子位是量子机器学习中的一个核心挑战：通过参数移位规则进行梯度估计很快就会变得非常昂贵，而无梯度优化器提供的收敛保证有限。我们将泡利传播框架应用于一类广泛的量子机器学习问题，其中损失表示为电路可观测量的期望值的函数，同时保持相关的感兴趣量，例如量子态或其样本，通常难以计算。通过在电路中向后传播可观测量，我们获得了损失的显式参数表达式，该损失可以在经典硬件上完全最小化。我们还提出了使大规模传播易于处理的补充策略，包括基于权重和基于度的截断以及修剪启发式。我们在 64 量子位电路上运行的两个基准测试上演示了该方法：二维 Ising 模型上的变分量子本征解算器，以及二值图像的离散型生成模型的训练。

在这两种情况下，经典的预训练参数都部署在 IBM 量子处理器 ibm_berlin 上。对于生成学习，我们还表明，这里考虑的电路比 IQP 风格的 ansätze 需要少得多的参数化门，从而减少了转换开销并使在当前量子硬件上的部署变得可行。

title: The Compendium of Super-Quadratic Computational Quantum Advantages
abstract: This compendium presents a structured collection of computational problems with credible prospects for realizing meaningful quantum advantage, focused on describing problem characteristics rather than specific algorithms. It is intended for non-quantum researchers and practitioners with strong computational backgrounds, particularly domain experts, seeking to assess the relevance of quantum methods to real-world problems. The compendium focuses on enumerating core problems for which there is good evidence that a quantum computer can realize more than a quadratic speedup in offline non-relativized time-complexity (e.g., as opposed to in oracular settings, streaming models, or communication advantages). Entries characterize the structural constraints that real-world instances must satisfy to realize those advantages in practice. The intention is to provide a reference that can be leveraged to connect quantum algorithms to practical use cases.
summary: 该纲要提出了计算问题的结构化集合，具有实现有意义的量子优势的可信前景，重点是描述问题特征而不是特定算法。它面向具有强大计算背景的非量子研究人员和从业者，特别是寻求评估量子方法与现实世界问题的相关性的领域专家。该纲要重点列举了一些核心问题，有充分的证据表明，量子计算机可以在离线非相对化时间复杂度上实现二次加速（例如，与神谕设置、流模型或通信优势相反）。条目描述了现实世界实例必须满足的结构约束，以在实践中实现这些优势。目的是提供一个参考，可用于将量子算法与实际用例联系起来。

title: QuantumBilliards.jl: An extensible, user friendly, high-performance Julia library for the large scale computation of spectra and eigenstates of quantum billiards and related problems
abstract: We present this http URL , an open-source Julia library providing a suite of numerical solvers for the two-dimensional interior Helmholtz eigenproblem with Dirichlet boundary conditions, a paradigmatic model in quantum chaos. The library implements conventional wavenumber-sweep techniques together with several accelerated eigensolvers: the Vergini--Saraceno scaling method, the expanded boundary integral method (EBIM), Beyn's contour-integral method, and the Compact Rational Krylov (CORK) method. It provides a common framework for constructing billiard geometries, exploiting discrete symmetries, computing eigenvalues and eigenstates, and treating smooth, cornered, and multiply connected domains. The library further includes reconstruction of eigenfunctions from boundary normal derivatives and the computation of Poincaré--Husimi (PH) phase-space representations. Available at: this https URL .
summary: 我们提出了这个 http URL ，这是一个开源 Julia 库，为具有狄利克雷边界条件的二维内部亥姆霍兹本征问题提供了一套数值求解器，这是量子混沌的范例模型。该库实现了传统的波数扫描技术以及几种加速本征解算器：Vergini-Saraceno 缩放方法、扩展边界积分方法 (EBIM)、Beyn 轮廓积分方法和紧凑有理 Krylov (CORK) 方法。它提供了一个通用框架，用于构建台球几何、利用离散对称性、计算特征值和特征态以及处理平滑域、角域和多重连通域。该库还包括根据边界法线导数重建本征函数以及庞加莱-胡西米 (PH) 相空间表示的计算。位于：此 https URL 。

title: Optimizing Quantum Battery via Counterdiabatic driving
abstract: We analyze the energy charging of a quantum battery within an open quantum framework, where the interaction between the battery element and an external power source is mediated by an ancilla system acting as a controllable switch. Specifically, we investigate the charging and discharging dynamics of a cavity-based quantum battery coupled to a driven qubit functioning as the charger. To ensure lossless power transfer, we utilize an adiabatic evolution protocol. Furthermore, we implement counterdiabatic driving, achieved by applying an auxiliary control field to the original Hamiltonian, to suppress undesired transitions and realize fast adiabatic dynamics. This scheme significantly accelerates the charging process. We demonstrate that the charging efficiency under adiabatic evolution is enhanced and exhibits stable, non-oscillatory behavior, and we determine the optimal duration for the operation. Finally, we show that counterdiabatic driving minimizes the path length between the initial and final states, inducing the shortest possible evolution distance.
summary: 我们分析了开放量子框架内量子电池的能量充电，其中电池元件和外部电源之间的相互作用是由充当可控开关的辅助系统介导的。具体来说，我们研究了与充当充电器的驱动量子位耦合的基于腔的量子电池的充电和放电动力学。为了确保无损功率传输，我们采用绝热演化协议。此外，我们通过对原始哈密顿量应用辅助控制场来实现反绝热驱动，以抑制不需要的转变并实现快速绝热动力学。该方案显着加速了充电过程。我们证明了绝热演化下的充电效率得到了提高，并表现出稳定的非振荡行为，并且我们确定了最佳的操作持续时间。最后，我们证明反绝热驱动最小化了初始状态和最终状态之间的路径长度，从而产生最短的可能进化距离。

title: Trace-distance characterization of recurrent pairwise synchronization in cavity-coupled superconducting qubits
abstract: We theoretically investigate recurrent pairwise synchronization in three super?conducting qubits coupled to a common single-mode microwave cavity. The qubits interact indirectly through the cavity field and are driven by a coher?ent microwave field. We obtain the coherent dynamics in the dressed-state basis and quantify pairwise synchronization by the trace distance between reduced single-qubit density matrices. The trace-distance dynamics exhibit oscillatory wave-packet structures, with low-trace-distance regions identifying finite syn?chronization windows. An envelope-threshold procedure is introduced to extract the representative duration of these windows. By varying the middle-qubit coupling strength and the relative coupling ratio of the outer qubits, we con?struct a parameter-dependent map of the synchronization-window duration. The duration decreases rapidly with increasing relative outer-qubit coupling and becomes weakly dependent on the middle-qubit coupling in the stronger-coupling regime. These results provide a reduced-state-based characterization of coherent collective dynamics in multiqubit circuit-QED systems.
summary: 我们从理论上研究了耦合到公共单模微波腔的三个超导量子位中的循环成对同步。量子位通过腔场间接相互作用，并由相干微波场驱动。我们获得了穿戴状态基础中的相干动力学，并通过简化的单量子位密度矩阵之间的迹线距离来量化成对同步。迹距动力学表现出振荡波包结构，低迹距区域识别有限的同步窗口。引入包络阈值过程来提取这些窗口的代表性持续时间。通过改变中间量子位耦合强度和外部量子位的相对耦合比，我们构建了同步窗口持续时间的参数相关图。随着相对外部量子位耦合的增加，持续时间迅速减少，并且在强耦合状态下变得弱依赖于中间量子位耦合。这些结果提供了多量子位电路 QED 系统中相干集体动力学的基于简化状态的表征。

title: An Invitation to Algebraic Methods in Quantum Theory
abstract: In this paper, we present various well-studied examples of quantum systems, and discuss how they might be analysed algebraically. We analyse the harmonic oscillator, hydrogenic atom, optical components, and particle spin using multiple algebraic methods, and highlight the central importance of algebraic relationships between operators in determining the physical character of the system. In particular, we show: the ubiquity of the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{so}(2,1)\cong\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ as the ``spectrum generating algebra''; the role of $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ and $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ in determining the action of optical components; that an elementary algebraic approach to particle spin offers novel insights into its nature versus the usual approaches; and how understanding the full (often hidden) symmetry of a problem enables it to be solved immediately without the need to solve differential equations. We hope this work will serve as a gentle introduction to algebraic methods in quantum mechanics for the interested reader --- we therefore signpost active areas of research within the community.
summary: 在本文中，我们提出了各种经过充分研究的量子系统示例，并讨论了如何对它们进行代数分析。我们使用多种代数方法分析谐振子、氢原子、光学成分和粒子自旋，并强调算子之间的代数关系在确定系统物理特性方面的核心重要性。特别是，我们展示： 李代数 $\mathfrak{so}(2,1)\cong\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ 作为“谱生成代数”的普遍性； $\mathfrak{su}(2)$ 和 $\mathfrak{su}(1,1)$ 在确定光学元件的作用中的作用；与通常的方法相比，粒子自旋的基本代数方法提供了对其本质的新颖见解；以及如何理解问题的完整（通常是隐藏的）对称性使其能够立即解决而无需求解微分方程。我们希望这项工作能够为感兴趣的读者提供对量子力学中代数方法的温和介绍——因此，我们在社区内标出了活跃的研究领域。

title: Elementary proofs of quantum lower bounds for element distinctness and k-sum
abstract: We give elementary proofs of the $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ quantum query lower bound for element distinctness and the $\Omega(n^{k/(k+1)})$ lower bound for the $k$-sum problem, for fixed $k$ and sufficiently large groups. The proofs use only basic properties of quantum states and linear algebra, analyzing the differences of algorithm states on different inputs.
summary: 对于固定的 $k$ 和足够大的组，我们给出了元素独特性的 $\Omega(n^{2/3})$ 量子查询下界和 $k$-sum 问题的 $\Omega(n^{k/(k+1)})$ 下界的基本证明。证明仅使用量子态和线性代数的基本性质，分析不同输入上算法状态的差异。

title: Optimal probes for estimating the dephasing of a quantum spin system
abstract: We investigate the optimal estimation of dephasing in finite-dimensional quantum spin systems. We first discuss some properties of the optimal probe states and present an efficient numerical algorithm to compute the optimal precision in dephasing estimation and identify the optimal probe states. For the dephasing channel arising from Gaussian phase diffusion, a spin cat state is known to be optimal for small dephasing. We analytically determine the range of dephasing strengths over which the cat state remains globally optimal for spins $J=1$ and $J=3/2$, and derive upper bounds on its optimality region for larger spins. We then compare numerically several probe states proposed in the literature, showing in particular that the simple class of probes obtained from uniform superpositions of all levels performs near-optimally for stronger dephasing. Finally, we apply our framework to a central-spin model coupled to a nuclear-spin bath, whose dynamics we simulate using the cluster-correlation expansion. Our results show that, while the cat state is optimal for weak Gaussian dephasing, pulse-controlled non-Markovian dynamics can favor states with amplitudes distributed over multiple spin levels, and in some cases the uniform state outperforms the other fixed probes considered. This shows how the choice of probe state depends both on the dephasing strength and on the dynamics.
summary:
我们研究了有限维量子自旋系统中相移的最佳估计。我们首先讨论最佳探针状态的一些属性，并提出一种有效的数值算法来计算移相估计的最佳精度并识别最佳探针状态。对于由高斯相位扩散产生的移相通道，已知自旋猫状态对于小移相来说是最佳的。我们通过分析确定了猫状态对于自旋 $J=1$ 和 $J=3/2$ 保持全局最优的移相强度范围，并得出了较大自旋的最优区域的上限。然后，我们在数值上比较了文献中提出的几种探针状态，特别表明，从所有级别的均匀叠加获得的简单探针类别对于更强的移相表现出近乎最佳的性能。最后，我们将我们的框架应用于与核自旋浴耦合的中心自旋模型，我们使用簇相关展开来模拟其动力学。

我们的结果表明，虽然猫状态对于弱高斯相移来说是最佳的，但脉冲控制的非马尔可夫动力学可以有利于振幅分布在多个自旋水平上的状态，并且在某些情况下，均匀状态优于所考虑的其他固定探针。这表明探针状态的选择如何取决于移相强度和动态。

title: Entanglement Asymmetry and Asymmetry Contour under Boundary Symmetry Breaking
abstract: We investigate how symmetry-breaking boundary magnetic fields affect magnetization and Rényi-2 entanglement asymmetry (EA) in the transverse-field Ising model. For the ground state, magnetization exhibits qualitatively distinct behaviors in the ordered and disordered phases. EA also exhibits phase-dependent behavior, which is well captured by the lower and upper bounds derived in this work. In the critical regime, both magnetization and EA exhibit behavior qualitatively consistent with the field-theoretical predictions for a related setup. We also study boundary-quench dynamics and find that magnetization propagates from the boundary into the bulk with a velocity consistent with the maximum quasiparticle velocity. In contrast, because EA is a subsystem-integrated quantity, its spatial structure is not directly resolved. We therefore introduce the asymmetry contour, a contour-like finite-difference quantity that provides a spatially resolved characterization of the symmetry-breaking information encoded in the reduced density matrix. The resulting contour is complementary to the local magnetization, retaining sensitivity to nonlocal many-body correlations while its dynamics also reflects the underlying quasiparticle propagation. These results show how EA and its contour can provide complementary information-theoretic characterizations of symmetry breaking and its spatial structure.
summary:
我们研究了对称破缺边界磁场如何影响横向场 Ising 模型中的磁化强度和 Rényi-2 纠缠不对称性 (EA)。对于基态，磁化在有序相和无序相中表现出性质不同的行为。 EA 还表现出相位相关行为，这一点可以通过本工作中导出的下限和上限很好地捕获。在临界状态下，磁化强度和 EA 的行为在质量上与相关设置的场论预测一致。我们还研究了边界淬灭动力学，发现磁化强度以与最大准粒子速度一致的速度从边界传播到本体中。相比之下，由于EA是一个子系统集成量，其空间结构无法直接解析。因此，我们引入了不对称轮廓，这是一种类似轮廓的有限差分量，它提供了在简化密度矩阵中编码的对称破缺信息的空间解析表征。

所得轮廓与局部磁化强度互补，保留对非局部多体相关性的敏感性，同时其动力学也反映了潜在的准粒子传播。这些结果表明 EA 及其轮廓如何提供对称破缺及其空间结构的补充信息论表征。

title: Bounding single-copy information causality violations
abstract: Information causality is a physical principle that constrains bipartite post-quantum nonlocal correlations from information-theoretic assumptions. A direct characterization of the correlations satisfying it, however, remains difficult because the defining entropic condition must hold for all admissible protocols in the corresponding task. Here, we formulate the single-copy information causality problem as an optimization over all protocol parameters and simplify it by proving a deterministic reduction. We then show that generic adaptive multi-copy protocols can be represented as single-copy protocols applied to an effective behavior obtained by local wirings. As a consequence, for families of correlations closed under wirings, excluding single-copy violations suffices to exclude all finite-copy adaptive-protocol violations. We formulate the resulting membership and set-inclusion problems as optimization problems and discuss possible semidefinite programming relaxations. As an application, we study expansions of the information causality functional around zero-capacity channels, generalizing a method recently employed by Gachechiladze and Miklin to derive the Tsirelson--Landau--Masanes boundary from information causality. For expansions centered on channels whose output distribution has full support, imposing the second-order constraints for all single-copy protocols characterizes exactly the set of macroscopic locality in the CHSH scenario. Expanding instead around appropriate constant-output channels with perturbations that change the channel support, we show that every single-copy IC violation can be witnessed already at first order with a channel of arbitrarily small capacity.
summary:
信息因果关系是一种物理原理，它根据信息论假设来约束二分后量子非局域相关性。然而，满足它的相关性的直接表征仍然很困难，因为定义的熵条件必须适用于相应任务中的所有可接受的协议。在这里，我们将单副本信息因果关系问题表述为对所有协议参数的优化，并通过证明确定性约简来简化它。然后，我们证明通用自适应多副本协议可以表示为应用于通过本地线路获得的有效行为的单副本协议。因此，对于在布线下封闭的相关族，排除单副本违规足以排除所有有限副本自适应协议违规。我们将由此产生的隶属度和集合包含问题表述为优化问题，并讨论可能的半定规划松弛。

作为一种应用，我们研究了围绕零容量通道的信息因果函数的扩展，概括了 Gachechiladze 和 Miklin 最近使用的一种方法，从信息因果关系中推导出 Tsirelson-Landau-Masanes 边界。对于以输出分布完全支持的通道为中心的扩展，对所有单副本协议施加二阶约束恰好表征了 CHSH 场景中的宏观局部性集。相反，围绕适当的恒定输出通道进行扩展，并通过改变通道支持的扰动，我们表明，每个单拷贝 IC 违规都可以在任意小容量的通道中在一阶被见证。

title: Exploiting the Weyl-Chamber Structure for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Compression
abstract: Quantum circuit compression based on tensor networks enables long-time simulation of quantum many-body dynamics on near-term hardware. While Riemannian optimization has been successfully employed for this purpose, it typically optimizes over the manifold of generic two-qubit unitaries. Consequently, the resulting gates must still be synthesized into the hardware's native gate set via KAK decomposition, an overhead that partially negates the original compression gain. We show that Riemannian-optimized gates already exhibit a predictable Weyl structure: near-$R_{ZZ}$ for the Ising model and near-fSim for the Heisenberg XXZ model. Building on this insight, we investigate whether parameterized optimization directly over the native gate set can offer a beneficial trade-off between expressivity and circuit efficiency by reducing the circuit's dimensionality. When comparing the two approaches, we find that the small residual Weyl parameters neglected by the latter are essential for high compression of the Ising propagator, whereas for the Heisenberg propagator, the native XXZ structure can be exploited directly to build a more efficient compressed circuit.
summary: 基于张量网络的量子电路压缩可以在近期硬件上对量子多体动力学进行长时间模拟。虽然黎曼优化已成功用于此目的，但它通常对通用双量子位酉流形进行优化。因此，生成的门仍然必须通过 KAK 分解合成到硬件的本机门集中，这是部分抵消原始压缩增益的开销。我们表明，黎曼优化门已经表现出可预测的 Weyl 结构：Ising 模型的近 $R_{ZZ}$ 和海森堡 XXZ 模型的近 fSim。基于这一见解，我们研究了直接在本机门集上进行参数化优化是否可以通过降低电路的维数来在表达能力和电路效率之间提供有益的权衡。在比较这两种方法时，我们发现后者忽略的小残余Weyl参数对于Ising传播器的高压缩至关重要，而对于Heisenberg传播器，可以直接利用原生XXZ结构来构建更高效的压缩电路。

title: Minimal unitary representations of time-invariant causal quantum channels
abstract: In this work, we study quantum channels that respect causality in single-input-single-output linear time-invariant systems. We show that positive semidefinite kernels satisfying certain analyticity constraints, which we call Schur-class kernels, provide a suitable description of such channels through multiplicative maps (Schur multipliers). Using the Moore-Aronszajn Theorem, we establish that these multipliers admit a minimal analytic Stinespring representation, which, in the unital case, is given by multiplication by a left inner function. We then relate the output rank of pure-state inputs to the dimension of the associated reproducing kernel Hilbert space. Using de Branges-Rovnyak realizations, we derive a stability criterion for the existence of two-sided inner completions of these vector-valued functions. We further show that the adjoint of the Julia embedding associated with the realization is minimal, and that its characteristic function essentially coincides with the canonical two-sided inner completion suggested by the Beurling-Lax-Halmos Theorem. Finally, we provide algorithms for explicitly computing minimal two-sided inner completions in the case of finite McMillan degree.
summary:
在这项工作中，我们研究了尊重单输入单输出线性时不变系统中因果关系的量子通道。我们证明，满足某些分析性约束的正半定核（我们称之为 Schur 类核）通过乘法映射（Schur 乘数）提供了此类通道的合适描述。使用 Moore-Aronszajn 定理，我们确定这些乘法器允许最小解析 Stinespring 表示，在单位情况下，它是通过乘以左内函数给出的。然后，我们将纯状态输入的输出等级与相关的再现核希尔伯特空间的维度相关联。使用 de Branges-Rovnyak 实现，我们推导了这些向量值函数的两侧内部完成的存在性的稳定性准则。我们进一步表明，与实现相关的 Julia 嵌入的伴随性是最小的，并且其特征函数本质上与 Beurling-Lax-Halmos 定理所提出的规范两侧内完成一致。

最后，我们提供了在有限麦克米伦度的情况下显式计算最小两侧内部完成的算法。

title: Certain Quantum States Already Require Quantum Time Evolution
abstract: Model-independent tests of quantum theory, such as Bell inequality violations, focus on static properties of the theory and do not rely on its dynamical aspects. Hence, this core part of quantum theory remains largely untested in a model-independent way. We show that the structure of quantum time evolution can be examined by testing the consistency between the state space and the dynamical laws. Considering a class of generalized phase-space theories, we find that certain quantum states can only be part of a theory if the time evolution is quantum: their evolution in anharmonic potentials would otherwise result in unphysical, negative marginal distributions. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the existence of the first excited state of a quantum harmonic oscillator is already sufficient to single out the Moyal bracket (quantum dynamics) to leading order in $\hbar^2$. We outline how theory-independent Wigner tomography of this state can be used to empirically exclude nonquantum dynamical theories.
summary: 量子理论的模型独立检验，例如贝尔不等式违反，侧重于理论的静态属性，而不依赖于其动态方面。因此，量子理论的这一核心部分在很大程度上仍未以独立于模型的方式进行测试。我们表明，可以通过测试状态空间和动力学定律之间的一致性来检查量子时间演化的结构。考虑一类广义相空间理论，我们发现，如果时间演化是量子的，某些量子态只能成为理论的一部分：否则它们在非调和势中的演化将导致非物理的负边际分布。此外，我们证明量子谐振子第一激发态的存在已经足以将 Moyal 括号（量子动力学）挑出 $\hbar^2$ 中的前导顺序。我们概述了如何使用该状态的与理论无关的维格纳断层扫描来凭经验排除非量子动力学理论。

title: Low-frustration block encodings by patch routing
abstract: Block-encoding has emerged as a core primitive in many quantum algorithms, including quantum simulation. In this work, we design efficient and extensible methods for generating low-frustration block encodings of frustrated lattice Hamiltonians built from repeated local interaction patches through a technique we call "patch routing". We construct block encodings for a full Hamiltonian by first block-encoding a small local patch and then using a SWAP-style routing network to coherently apply the local patch encoding across the lattice. The expensive, local block-encoding cost is paid only once per query and is independent of lattice size, whereas the comparatively inexpensive routing network grows linearly with the lattice size, dominating at large sizes. Our method allows for a hierarchical structure in which larger patches can be block-encoded with small normalization factors, albeit at a higher (local, non-extensive) block-encoding cost, thereby reducing overall query complexity in an algorithm. We exploit symmetries and algebraic structures in local interactions to construct efficient block encodings, and we apply these techniques to the Heisenberg, Fermi-Hubbard, and honeycomb spin-liquid models. For a $120\times 120$ square-lattice $J_1$-$J_2$ Heisenberg model near maximal frustration ($J_2/J_1=0.4-0.6$), our methods result in a $15-17\times$ reduction in the leading $T$ cost per qubitized-QPE run (ignoring initial state preparation and overlap) relative to prior state-of-the-art Pauli LCU constructions. Corresponding reductions are approximately $3\times$ for the $120\times120$ Fermi-Hubbard model at half-filling. For time evolution of the honeycomb spin-liquid model on $120\times120$ unit cells, the leading cost is reduced by $5\times$. Our framework provides a systematic way forward for larger and more accurate fault-tolerant simulations of real-world quantum systems.
summary:
块编码已成为许多量子算法（包括量子模拟）的核心原语。在这项工作中，我们设计了高效且可扩展的方法，用于通过我们称为“补丁路由”的技术从重复的局部交互补丁构建受挫格哈密顿量的低挫败块编码。我们通过首先对一个小的局部补丁进行块编码，然后使用 SWAP 式路由网络在整个网格上连贯地应用局部补丁编码来构建完整哈密顿量的块编码。昂贵的本地块编码成本每次查询只需支付一次，并且与晶格大小无关，而相对便宜的路由网络随晶格大小线性增长，在大尺寸中占主导地位。我们的方法允许采用分层结构，其中较大的补丁可以使用较小的归一化因子进行块编码，尽管块编码成本较高（本地、非扩展），从而降低了算法中的整体查询复杂性。

我们利用局部相互作用中的对称性和代数结构来构建有效的块编码，并将这些技术应用于海森堡、费米-哈伯德和蜂窝自旋液体模型。对于接近最大挫折的 $120\times 120$ 方格 $J_1$-$J_2$ 海森堡模型 ($J_2/J_1=0.4-0.6$)，相对于先前最先进的 Pauli LCU 结构，我们的方法导致每次量子化 QPE 运行的领先 $T$ 成本减少 $15-17\times$（忽略初始状态准备和重叠）。对于半填充的 120\times120$ 费米-哈伯德模型，相应的减少约为 $3\times$。对于 $120\times120$ 单元上的蜂窝自旋液体模型的时间演化，主要成本降低了 $5\times$。我们的框架为对现实世界的量子系统进行更大、更准确的容错模拟提供了一种系统的方法。

title: Distributed Quantum-Centric Supercomputing with Multi-Layered Generative Learning for Intermolecular Interactions
abstract: Quantum-centric supercomputing (QCSC) approaches, such as sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), combine quantum processors with high-performance computers (HPC), offering a promising route toward solving challenging electronic structure problems. However, implementation of QCSC approaches to large active space calculations is constrained by the associated number of qubits, deep quantum circuits, sampling cost, and large-scale Hamiltonian diagonalization. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a distributed QCSC framework that decomposes complex molecular problems into parallel sub-problems requiring fewer qubits, shallower circuits, and reduced shot budgets. A physically motivated, two-step aggregation scheme then reconstructs the global solution: first, a computational bit assignment strategy optimizes a cost function to appropriately map local bit indices to global ones, yielding a mapped tensor product state (MTPS); second, an inter-fragment correlation recovery module restores missing cross-fragment interactions. Herein, we employ a multi-layered generative machine learning architecture, starting with utilizing the recently proposed physics-informed generative SQD (PIGen-SQD) as a distributed QCSC solver, followed by a secondary generative module to model configuration distributions and identify dominant sectors of the global Hilbert space. For water and formamide dimers, our method achieves up to $95\%$ reduction in the diagonalization dimension while enhancing energy accuracy by an order of magnitude over conventional SQD. Furthermore, application to the water hexamer ($\mathrm{(H_2O)_6}$) cage successfully decomposes a 120-qubit problem into six 20-qubit monomeric subsystems, and stitches the monomers under a dimeric approximation, demonstrating excellent agreement with the reference classical methods.
summary:
以量子为中心的超级计算 (QCSC) 方法，例如基于样本的量子对角化 (SQD)，将量子处理器与高性能计算机 (HPC) 相结合，为解决具有挑战性的电子结构问题提供了一条有前途的途径。然而，QCSC 方法在大型活动空间计算中的实施受到相关量子位数量、深度量子电路、采样成本和大规模哈密顿对角化的限制。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了分布式 QCSC 框架，该框架将复杂的分子问题分解为需要更少量子位、更浅电路和更少射击预算的并行子问题。然后，物理驱动的两步聚合方案重建全局解决方案：首先，计算位分配策略优化成本函数，以适当地将局部位索引映射到全局位索引，产生映射的张量积状态（MTPS）；其次，片段间相关性恢复模块恢复丢失的跨片段交互。

在这里，我们采用多层生成机器学习架构，首先利用最近提出的物理信息生成 SQD (PIGen-SQD) 作为分布式 QCSC 求解器，然后是二次生成模块来对配置分布进行建模并识别全局希尔伯特空间的主导部分。对于水和甲酰胺二聚体，我们的方法可将对角化维数减少高达 $95\%$，同时将能量精度比传统 SQD 提高一个数量级。此外，应用于水六聚体 ($\mathrm{(H_2O)_6}$) 笼成功地将 120 量子位问题分解为六个 20 量子位单体子系统，并在二聚体近似下缝合单体，证明与参考经典方法具有良好的一致性。
